summary: First testing pass. Verified critical infra fix (Next.js frontend on :3000 + FastAPI backend on :8001 owning /api/checkout). Public pages 200 OK, /api/checkout reaches backend and returns structured JSON errors (not 502). All required UI changes verified: wordmark header/footer, About Us Mission+Founder sections, checkout deposit option removed, Square Brand Approved badge visible, single 'Pay Full Amount' button.
action_items: None blocking. Reminder: Square Web Payments card iframe shows 'secure card form failed to load' due to placeholder NEXT_PUBLIC_SQUARE_APPLICATION_ID — expected/known, resolved when user supplies real sandbox App ID.
Consider adding zustand `persist` middleware to cartStore so cart survives full page refresh (currently in-memory only; SPA nav works fine). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: cartStore.ts uses in-memory zustand without persist middleware — cart is lost on hard refresh / direct navigation. Client-side Link navigation works, so this doesn't break the primary flow, but persist() is recommended.
backend/server.py: CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically an invalid CORS combo (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Acceptable for now since no cookies are used.
backend/.env has placeholder Square token committed — ensure real production secret is only set via deployment env, never committed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://b0b1c486-a310-4321-877e-5f653e700291.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend at /api/checkout on port 8001 (FastAPI), Next.js frontend serves all other paths on port 3000. Cart uses zustand in-memory (no persist); to reach /checkout with items you must click 'Initiate Order Request' in the cart drawer (SPA nav), not page.goto(). Square placeholder credentials mean full payment success cannot be e2e-tested — a 401/402 JSON response from Square sandbox is the expected end-state.
